questions.question: Explain the difference between similar and congruent figures, using the 10 × 15 cm photo and its 20 × 30 cm enlargement.
questions.expected_answer: Congruent figures have the same shape and size; similar figures have the same shape, with all sides multiplied by the same scale factor. Two 10 × 15 photos are congruent; the 20 × 30 enlargement is similar (scale factor 2) but not congruent.

questions.question: Is a 10 × 25 cm print similar to a 10 × 15 cm photo? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: No. The width is multiplied by 1 and the length by 5/3; the scale factors differ, so the shape has changed.

questions.question: Decide whether triangles with sides 3, 4, 5 and 6, 8, 10 are similar, congruent or neither.
questions.expected_answer: Similar, not congruent: each ratio 6/3 = 8/4 = 10/5 = 2, the same scale factor, but not 1.
